catalogs.name: Linkiir FHIR Adapters
catalogs.description: Adapters Linkiir Grid speaks over FHIR: FHIR-native EHR and EMR APIs, and FHIR authoring tools.

catalogs.name: Linkiir EHR Adapters
catalogs.description: Adapters for EHR, EMR and practice-management systems reached over a proprietary API rather than FHIR.

catalogs.name: Linkiir Diagnostics Adapters
catalogs.description: Adapters for results and signals arriving from an instrument: laboratories, imaging, and bedside or wearable devices.

catalogs.name: Linkiir Business Adapters
catalogs.description: Enterprise business system adapters: CRM, ERP, ITSM, HR, identity and directory services, and scheduling.

catalogs.name: Linkiir Transport Adapters
catalogs.description: Adapters for moving bytes and messages: object storage, file transport, and streaming or message brokers.

catalogs.name: Linkiir Notification Adapters
catalogs.description: Adapters that put a message in front of a person: chat, SMS, voice, email, paging and webhooks.

catalogs.name: Linkiir AI Adapters
catalogs.description: Model and AI service adapters: hosted and on-premise LLMs, embeddings, and AI tooling.

catalogs.name: Linkiir Developer Tools
catalogs.description: Tools for building and testing interfaces, such as a Data Simulator that emits synthetic HL7 v2, C-CDA, FHIR and X12 messages.
